title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 DualSense Controllers Revealed
description: Two limited edition Grand Theft Auto 6 PS5 DualSense controllers have been officially revealed during the latest Sony State of Play livestream.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Two Limited Edition GTA 6 PS5 DualSense Controllers Revealed at State of Play

Exciting news for hardware collectors and fans eagerly awaiting the next chapter in the franchise: during the latest Sony State of Play livestream, two limited edition Grand Theft Auto 6 PS5 DualSense controllers were officially revealed, according to gaming media outlet Eurogamer.

While the live stream focused on showcasing upcoming experiences, the surprise reveal of these themed controllers highlights the growing promotional momentum surrounding the highly anticipated open-world blockbuster. The PlayStation 5's DualSense controller, known for its immersive haptic feedback and adaptive triggers, is widely seen by players as an ideal match for the intricate gameplay mechanics expected in GTA 6.

## Expanding the Franchise's Hardware Lineup

Major entertainment releases often coincide with bespoke hardware iterations, and the introduction of these two limited edition controllers suggests that players will have unique ways to customize their setups when diving into the game. Although details regarding pricing, exact release dates, and regional availability were not part of the initial State of Play announcement, the mere confirmation of their existence has already generated significant buzz across the gaming community.

As anticipation continues to build toward the eventual launch of GTA 6, fans and collectors alike will certainly be keeping a close eye on further announcements regarding these collectible peripherals.

## Editor's Take

Announcing two limited edition DualSense controllers during State of Play is a brilliant move to keep hardware enthusiasts engaged. While we await more specifics on pricing and release dates, these controllers are shaping up to be must-have items for die-hard fans looking to fully experience the next era of PlayStation gaming.
